The native compiled-prefix immutable mmap artifact exercised 1M/10M set/fact shards, corruption, structural validation and durable atomic pointer activation. At 10M prefaulted entries native prefix p99 was about 0.92 microseconds for sets and 2.71 microseconds for facts; lazy random access reached about 7.3/72.3 microseconds p99. Full heap expansion and three-generation residency are capacity risks; shared-page accounting was inconclusive on the old host kernel.
